note: Order from the 1-ID-B panel (p12), beam entering at the red arrow on the left. ICs sit above the beam line on the panel, devices below it; the red number next to each IC is its count at photo time (reading-to-IC assignment is by proximity). The panel draws a second boxed group (BL3-BL5, IC7) after B-TOM.

elements.name: Al CRL
elements.notes: Aluminium compound refractive lenses. No code device found.

elements.name: HRM
elements.notes: High-resolution monochromator; drawn as two blue triangles with IC4 between them (probably the two crystals). No code device found.

elements.name: IC4
elements.notes: Sits between the two HRM triangles on the panel.

elements.name: Foil
elements.notes: Energy reference (K-edge) for the HEM calibration, per earlier user notes. An orange value 0.004 sits above it on the panel (meaning unknown).

elements.name: IC8
elements.notes: Numbered 8 but placed after IC5 and the foil/attenuator, before the stacks.

elements.name: Stack1 (first)
elements.notes: Panel labels both stacks 'Stack1'. Matching to lens4B/lens5B in mpe_bluesky is a guess (mpe_bluesky lens4B motors m19-m24 listed here; lens5B m26,m29,m45-m48).

elements.name: Cork
elements.notes: Panel shows 112 mm and On/Off buttons. Function not recorded (user to confirm).

elements.name: B-TOM
elements.notes: B-hutch tomo detector translation stage. The profile camera 'retiga2' (hutch B, PV prefix not recorded) is presumably the camera on it (unconfirmed).

elements.name: BL3
elements.notes: In the second boxed group on the B panel. Meaning unknown (user to explain).

elements.name: (magenta marker)
elements.notes: Magenta dashed circle at the end of the beam line on the B panel; probably the beam-stop/handoff to the next hutch (unconfirmed).
